
A series of humid dimly lit caverns inhabited by feral Rockrunners called, "Terrorscales". The entire cave is a mirky swamp like biome of bioluminescent plants and glowing crystals. Everywhere here is only dimly lit unless said otherwise. There is a constant echoing sound of dripping water through every pathway. The caves are thing and tall with many vines branching between the walls, the rising ceilings get darker as they go up, shrouding the top levels in darkness.
##### **UNIQUE CREATURES:**
- *Broodguard*: Large buff lizards that walk on all fours, massive clawed hands that it uses to fight. They are the guardians of the nest. 
- *Spinefang*: Velociraptors, medium and fast hunters that swarm enemies. These ae the general population of the nest.
- *Terrorscale*: Huge T-Rex monsters, have triceratops shield skulls and massive sabretooth tiger fangs. 
- *The Feathered Matron*: GIGANTIC! The mother, giant flying dinosaur with razor sharp talons. She commands the nest and is the queen of the nest.
Statblocks:
- [[broodguard.png]]
- [[spinefang.png]] (14 AC not 18)
- [[terrorscale.png]]
- feathered matron ([[adult wasteland dragon.png]])


## Room 1: The Entrance

The long overgrown tunnel leads to what appears to once have been a well maintained mechanical entrance. The roof above you is covered in crystals and faintly glowing plants. 
*The Altar*: On the west side of the room resides an overgrown table, when dusted or foliage is removed the mechanical control center becomes visible. It appears to be a device of some kind, you can follow the warm pipes from some kind of slot all the way to the door on the east side of the room. There is a cube shaped slot in the center that has wiring running in every direction from it. Inserting the cube from below will open the east door.
*The Control Cube*: If they investigate or passive perception check (DC 19), they find a small lump beside the table that appears to be some kind of plant bulb. It is similar to a Venus fly trap, and opens if they touch it, revealing a small red and bronze cube. The cube can be grabbed with a DC 16 Dexterity check, on a  failure the plant snatches your arm dealing 7 damage and holding you grappled until you are pulled out.

**East Door**. The east door whirs to life as steam can be seen funneling through its glass pipes, rotating the massive latch in the center. The door only opens a couple feet as the rusted and overgrown machinery struggles against its wear and tear. (DC 18 Athletics check to push it open the rest of the way.)


## Room 2: The Forgotten Hall

The doorway opens to the bottom of a large ravine. The constant echoing sound of water droplets rings in your ears faintly. The pathway is thin and tall, with massive vines and foliage hanging between the walls. before you there is a small room almost as if the ravine has grown into and out of the ancient hallways, overtaking what once was. 
*The Carvings*: On the east wall is the last remains of the Aelarian designed caverns in this room. There are letterings and images. You see a floating city in the sky, many people living in it, and a silver dragon in the sky protecting them. A red dragon breathes fire at the city. The wording below reads, "When the Red Plague Rymanth came for blood, Poryntos answered."
*The Remains*: A pile of bones lies in the room, they are covered in vines, but the remains look fresh. Upon further investigation you the chest plate cracked beside the body bears a white crystal symbol, and the skull has fangs. The body is broken, there are claw marks and shattered bones as if they were smashed to bits. 

**North Passage**. The tunnel continues north into a larger section of the ravine. A low wet and muddled breathing can be heard as you move forward. 


## Room 3: The Guardian's Horde

As you follow the tunnel you find what can only be described as a graveyard. Tens of bodies, stripped of flesh and skin, the armor of Calcite guard strewn through every corner of the room, a pile of skulls sits in the north. As you walk forwards (they can stealth DC 20) two small mounds of foliage and dirt erupt as massive lizards, big rock drakes with heavier more fortified scales and massive clawed hands leap forward at you, ROLL INITIATIVE!
*Enemies*: 2x [[broodguard.png]] 2x [[spinefang.png]]


**West Crack**. There is a tiny crack in the wall, it can be traversed by medium players with a dexterity check DC 16, if you fail you get stuck and have to get help from someone. It leads to Room b.

**North Passage**. The large northern end of the ravine leads to a solid stone walled Aelarian hallway with its iconic brass and glass piping. Leads to Room a.


## Room a: The Pit Trap

You see the cave blend back int the Aelarian architecture, the walls of white ornate plaster and marble, and the floor is a beautiful brass filled with pipes running across it. Int he center of the hallway is a large silver circle.
At the west end of the hallway you can see a large cavern, barely lit but you can make out some stone circles lined with foliage and straw.
*Pit Trap*: If they step in the hallway, the pit activates. Anyone on the 35ft of hallway marked on the battle map falls into a 35x20 ft hole. Falling 60ft, taking 6d6 bludgeoning damage

**West End**. The west end of the hallway leads into the Terrorscale nest.


## ROOM 4: The Terrorscale Nest

This massive chamber's walls rise higher than you can see, going darker and darker as they rise, obscuring your view of what may lie above in the stones and foliage. There are two large circles of rocks rising 10ft off the ground.
*The Nests*: The rocks are two Terrorscale nests, the north has two glowing green and silver eggs, almost 5ft tall. The south is empty. If they investigate the nests they notice that they are built on top of large concentrations of Aelarian piping in the floor, which appears to be active and powering something below...
*Enemies*: [[terrorscale.png]] After they enter the nest and investigate the nests, a Terrorscale leaps down from above.
*Loot*: 1x Terrorscale Egg (small, fits in the palm of your hand), worth 8000 GP

**The West Passage**. The west passage leads down a thin hallway lined with massive claw marks, as if something massive had climbed across them. It diverges south and north. South leads to the hiding room, north leads to the next main room.

**The South Crack**. There is a tiny crack in the wall, it can be traversed by medium players with a dexterity check DC 16, if you fail you get stuck and have to get help from someone. It leads to Room b.


## ROOM b: The Treasure Hold

There is a pile of gems, and two treasure chests. They appear to have survived the overgrowth decently, but still are difficult to open. The chests are locked by a DC 18 thieves tools check or a AC 20 lock.
*Loot*: 
- *Pile*: 15 assorted gemstones worth 5GP each, 6 Azurite worth 10 GP each, 3 Garnets worth 500GP each
- *West Chest*: 1x Control Cube
- *North Chest*: [[Sandstone Sheath]]


## ROOM 5: The Hiding Room

A small unreachable cavern by the Nest's inhabitants, this little cave holds a small pool of water in its center, and is inhabited by two Calcite Guard soldiers. Their names are Reikard and Lincoln. They were tasked to steal Terrorscale eggs to raise them as weapons for the Vampire army.
If they fight, 2x [[vampire.png]]
If they bargain, the guards just want to escape, if the party lets them go they will leave the cavern and Ironpetal, forsaking killing mortals forever.


## ROOM c: The Glass Floor

The winding cave leads across a section of murky glass (Passive Perception 16 or a perception/investigation check reveals sound below.)
IF THEY LOOK" You see a large two tiered room with a balcony overlooking a group of students working diligently to repair control cubes as Calcite Guards watch them intently. There is a large pile of bodies in the corner.
You hear a loud hum of machines and steam emitting from the hallway ahead.

**West Passage**. The west passage leads to a large stone boulder rolled in front of an archway. It can be moved with a DC 25 Strength check, this leads to The Acid Pool.


## ROOM 6: The Acid Pool

A large chamber, with what appears to be a sickly purple pool of liquid. There is a door that drops directly off of a 10ft ledge into the pool. There are 4 assorted pillars that reach out o the pool and appear safe to stand on. If they use the pillars they must make a dexterity check, below a 16 causes a rock to fall into the pool, and it awakens the Hydras!
*Enemies*: 2x [[Hydra]] A set of 10 heads appear up from the water and attack, HYDRAS! ROLL INITIATIVE!


## ROOM d: The Slippery Slope

The stairs are tall and crudely carved by time. They are coated in a thick gooey film, make a Dexterity Saving Throw (DC 16). On a failure you slip and slide down the stairs, banging and crashing against rocks taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage and sliding into the open Broodguard Chamber.

**West Stairs**. The stairs continue downwards and lead to the Broodguard Chamber.


## ROOM 7: The Broodguard Chamber

A large towering cavern housing many Broodguard, the last line of defense before the Queen's nest. There are large towering pillars where the guards rest.
*The Water Pool*: A large still pool of water, it is very deep, and appears to have a tunnel beneath it leading downwards. Following this will lead you to the steam supply system room in the Catacombs.
*Enemies*: (Slide) As you slide into the room you land directly in front of a Broodguard Sentinel, its massive fist instantly rises and lashes its claws out at you, ROLL INITIATIVE! Many more guards come spewing from the floor and caverns around. 5x [[broodguard.png]]
*Loot*: Broodguard blood, can be used as a covering to mask your scent and allow you to sneak through the nest.

**Southeast Passage**. The hall leads to a massive boulder rolled in front of an even larger doorway, behind the boulder you can hear the rumbles and breath of something gigantic. (DC30 Strength check to move the boulder.) This leads to the Queen's Nest.


## ROOM 8: The Queen's Nest

The largest chamber in the cave system, massive nests and eggs are visible through the chamber along with sleeping creatures throughout. There is a massive rumbling and echoing breath from somewhere within (above). The exit can be seen on the south side, leading downwards between the Aelarian architecture and vulgar caves.
*The Nests*: Interacting in any way with the eggs will awaken the Queen, and you can draw her aggro by doing so, when someone takes an egg she will attack the last person to hold it no matter what, and if they are standing in the nest she will charge towards it, attacking her own allies if they are in her way. If she reaches the nest unhindered she will slam her head into the wall on any missed attacks taking 4d6 bludgeoning damage.
*Enemies*: 1x [[adult wasteland dragon.png]], 1x [[terrorscale.png]]. Hanging from the ceiling is a scaled monstrosity. Huge, its sickly purple and green scales accompanied by a flurry of feathers of grey and blue, its similar to a wyvern but with a more bird like beak and the head of a wolf.
*Loot*:
- *West Nest*: [[Bone Gauntlets]]
- *East Nest*: Aelarian Whispering Root (they don't know what this is yet)
- *South Nest*: [Alchemical Compendium](https://dnd5e.wikidot.com/wondrous-items:alchemical-compendium)

**South Passage**. The south passage transitions from cave to hallway, and leads down a long set of stairs towards [[Cain's Catacombs]], specifically the Control Hall. (This is the center room.)
